item.name: Refresh access token using httpOnly refresh token cookie

request.description: The server reads the refresh token from the `refresh_token` httpOnly cookie set during login. No request body is required. The cookie is sent automatically by the browser on same-origin requests. The response sets a new `refresh_token` httpOnly cookie alongside the new access token.

item.name: Verify QR ticket and mark attendance (admin/staff)

request.description: Verifies the QR ticket JWT and marks the participant as attended. A `200` response is always returned for a structurally valid request — the `status` field in the body indicates the scan outcome (`success`, `already_attended`, or `invalid`). A `401` is returned only when the caller's **staff/admin Bearer token** is missing or expired, not for invalid ticket tokens (those return 200 with status: invalid).
